newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli helicopters hit southeastern Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli helicopters hit southeastern Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli helicopter gunships rocketed suspected guerrilla targets in southeastern Lebanon before dawn on Wednesday, security sources said.
The sources said the helicopters launched raids on the area around the villages of Qilya and Mazra'at ad-Dallafi north of the eastern sector of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
"They bombarded the area with air-to-surface missiles," one sources said. There was no immediate report of casualties.
It was not immediately known if there were any guerrilla raids against the Israeli-held zone before the air attack.
Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas and other fighters are waging war on Israeli and allied militia forces in south Lebanon in a bid to oust them.
